evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce PCFBench, the first benchmark to carve PCF modeling into independently-evaluable tasks that require decomposition, retrieval, ontology matching, and numerical extraction.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: AI agents are increasingly being used to generate PCFs, but existing evaluations score either total emissions (hiding error sources and cancelling mistakes) or sub-tasks in isolation (missing compositional interactions).
